study_metadata.title: Stage 1D Revised Research & Ablation Registry
study_metadata.governance: Replaces speculative 136-ablation matrix with hypothesis-driven, empirically grounded priorities.

empirical_justification.finding_1: RR-GBDT achieves AUROC 0.9663 (11 patients) and 0.9938 (30 patients) with positive Brier Skill Score (+0.6381), proving rhythm alone carries decisive AF information.
empirical_justification.finding_2: Pure morphology SetOperator (A001, D032-v1) achieves negative Brier Skill Scores (-0.0560, -0.0592) and near-chance within-patient AUROC (~0.53-0.57), establishing zero clinical predictive skill over constant prevalence.
empirical_justification.finding_3: Multimodal G061 suffers catastrophic single-lead asymmetry under genuine channel dropout: AUROC 0.9232 on Lead 0 vs 0.1885 on Lead 1 (inverted polarity), proving unmasked evaluations previously masked severe failure.
empirical_justification.finding_4: Charitos continuous density metric is mathematically and empirically translation-invariant under lower-envelope formulation L(m), while naive cumulative area fails.

prioritized_stage2_campaigns.name: Chronological Beat-Sequence & SSM Rhythm Modeling
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.rationale: Given RR interval dominance (AUROC > 0.96), sequence modeling over actual chronological R-R intervals using bidirectional Mamba / S4 / GRU architectures will capture fine-grained ventricular irregularity dynamics far better than static 30s summary statistics.
candidate_architectures: R-Mamba: Bidirectional Selective State Space Model over 60-RR sequences
R-GRU: 2-layer Bidirectional GRU with attention pooling over beat intervals
R-Transformer: 4-layer Beat-Interval Self-Attention with sinusoidal position embeddings
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.evaluation_gate: Must exceed RR-GBDT AUROC (0.9663) and achieve Brier Skill Score > +0.65.

prioritized_stage2_campaigns.name: Symmetric Channel-Dropout & Lead-Contrastive Representation
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.rationale: G061 collapsed to 0.1885 on Lead 1 because training lacked symmetric channel dropout. Models must be trained with random Bernoulli(0.5) lead masking and contrastive InfoNCE loss enforcing representation invariance across Lead 0 and Lead 1.
candidate_architectures: SimLead-G061: Symmetric cross-lead contrastive pretraining with hard dropout
LeadAgnostic-ResNet: Shared-weight 1D ResNet with lead permutation invariance
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.evaluation_gate: Must maintain AUROC > 0.90 across both Pattern 0 (Lead 0) and Pattern 1 (Lead 1).

prioritized_stage2_campaigns.name: Genuine Segmented Beat-Level QRS-T Morphology
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.rationale: Static Phase-KME failed because it compresses the entire 30s recording into an unaligned kernel mean embedding. Real clinical value requires extracting segmented P-QRS-T complexes aligned to detected R-peaks.
candidate_architectures: BeatMorph-Transformer: Set transformer over individual aligned QRS-T complexes
Rhythm-Conditioned BeatMorph: Dual-stream architecture where rhythm attends to beat morphology
prioritized_stage2_campaigns.evaluation_gate: Must demonstrate statistically significant incremental AUROC (+0.02) over rhythm-only baseline.

deprioritized_or_cancelled_directions.direction: Continuous Coordinate Scaling on Unsegmented Phase-KME (A001-A004)
deprioritized_or_cancelled_directions.reason: Empirically demonstrated zero predictive skill (negative BSS, near-chance within-patient ranking). Further parameter scaling on flawed representations is unscientific.
HSMM all-AF degeneracy was fully resolved by Platt calibration. Emission strength tuning without proper probability calibration is obsolete.
Ablations on architectures that fail baseline non-inferiority waste compute. Only models clearing Stage 1D gates enter the ablation pipeline.
